crop.notes: The top half is 'The Trial of Justice McAuliffe', unrelated. Only the 'Pugilistic Personals' item below it is about Allen; it is complete.

ocr.notes: Allen item is readable; one line garbled ('the belt proposed for Allen some time ago will be presented by his friends').

summary.suggested: The Missouri Republican reported that Tom Allen, with Mace's agent Abrahams, arrived in St. Louis showing few marks of his fight, and that an exhibition with Mace was planned for Saturday night, when friends would present Allen a belt.

metadata.notes: Masthead reads 'The Missouri Republican--St. Louis, May 24, 1870.' It became the St. Louis Republic only in 1888.

facts.fact: Allen arrived in St. Louis with Mace's agent Abrahams after the Mace fight; Mace had stayed over at Memphis to recuperate
A sparring exhibition between Mace and Allen was planned in St. Louis for Saturday night, when the belt proposed for Allen some time before would be presented by his friends
There was talk of another match between Allen and Mike McCoole

notes: Exhibition was planned, not reported as held.
